og.alt: State Tree: The MobX-State-Tree model, with 9.5× faster actions. 9.5× faster action calls than MobX-State-Tree 9.

hero.alt: A Counter model created with count 5. counter.increment() sets count to 6; onPatch receives { op: 'replace', path: '/count', value: 6 } and onSnapshot adds { count: 6 } to the history. Undo calls applySnapshot(counter, { count: 5 }): the count returns to 5 and a new patch with value 5 is emitted.
